title: GitHub Repository Posture Hardening

operatorSteps.title: Review repository posture assessment
operatorSteps.instruction: Review branch protection, workflow permissions, CODEOWNERS, secret scanning, dependency review, and environment protection findings.

operatorSteps.title: Plan repository controls
operatorSteps.instruction: Draft a non-executing plan for branch protection, workflow token permissions, action restrictions, CODEOWNERS, secret scanning, dependency review, and environment reviewers.

operatorSteps.title: Record reassessment command
operatorSteps.instruction: Record the reassessment command to run after approved repository controls are applied.

recommendedControls: Require pull request reviews on protected branches.
Set default workflow token permissions to read-only.
Restrict third-party actions or pin them by SHA.
Enable secret scanning and push protection where available.
Require reviewers for protected deployment environments.
nonClaims: This playbook does not mutate repository settings.
This playbook does not dispatch workflows.
This playbook does not access secrets.
This playbook does not authorize live remediation.
